license_note: Meta publishes the weights, tokenizer, and original checkpoints under the custom Llama 3.3 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. The policy's European Union exclusion applies only to multimodal Llama 3.3 models, so it does not bind this text-only release, but the use-based terms still make it source-available rather than open source.

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct release dated December 6, 2024. The Llama 3.1 70B base model it was tuned from, quantizations, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Meta publishes both Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards and original consolidated checkpoints with a checklist file
The model card names the governing license, the base model, a release date, and a static-model status statement
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind a contact-information agreement and the custom license carries attribution, scale, and acceptable-use restrictions
The model card documents no hosted serving paths, so independent availability must be verified with each operator
